desc: Assassinating becomes more of an art at this point... Use an attack that does major damage if the opponent isn't facing you! PhysOff+++ Tech++
You learn to take out opponents unexpectedly. PhysOff+ PhysDef+ Tech++
You've learned to increase the efficiency and speed of your strikes, allowing you to down a opponent with 100 attacks. Physoff++ Tech++++
Your attacks can start severely damaging specific limbs. PhysOff++ Tech++
Your technique related to grabs increases. PhysOff+ Tech++
Through your technique, let your attacks echo throughout the opponent Tech+++
Your stealthy nature begins to manifest. PhysOff+ Tech++
Your ruthless nature manifests in your fighting style, letting you temporarily stun a opponent by playing dirty. Physoff+ Tech++++
Your defenses are ironclad. Unpenetrable and absolutely invincible. Your Ki defends even against the subatomic. Defense++++
Increase your physical defense and offense even more, at a small price to Ki. Physoff+ Physdef+ Tech+
Channel your Ki into your arms, increasing offense. Ki Skill+, Speed+++

\"CHANGE... NOW!!\" - Captain Ginyu\nBodychange, also known as Bodyswap, is the ability to swap other's body with your own. It shoots out a purple beam for a second, anyone who touches it swaps minds with yourself.
Y-you're fucking stacked. You no longer have a mere 'six pack' or whatever those mortals call it. /fit/ certified. P.Off+, P.Def+, Spd+

Depending on your Trinity, gain a unique passive ability. Van-sama: Increased defense the lower your health is. Ricardo: Gain increased regeneration. Also willpower and technique depending on your health and ki. Aniki: Increased offense the lower your health is.
Your body becomes much harder, allowing yourself to take attacks more easily. P.Def++
One hundred pushups! One hundred situps! One hundred squats! Ten kilometer run, every single day!
When fighting a foe, the longer you don't attack, the more damage your next attack will do. Also, gain some more hidden potential and physical offense.
Gain a increase to an attack proportional to how long you've trained before that fight. Also, gain some more hidden potential and physical offense.
Slowly grind your skills as a swordsman.
From your hugeness, a faint whisper has begun in your ear! It's time to choose...
If your knockback is on, you gain a small physical offense boost. If it's off, your gains increase but your physical offense is worse. +Stamina Gain.
Whatever it is you're doing, it's making you less tired from doing everything else... StamGain+, Will+, Satiety+
Instead of increasing stamina, this is another chance to continue increasing your stats by training (sparring or boxing).
Increase your stamina gain, willpower, and nutrition gain. Also, by training (sparring or boxing) you can slowly increase your physical stats some more.

\"Empty your mind, be formless, shapeless — like water. Now you put water in a cup, it becomes the cup; You put water into a bottle it becomes the bottle; You put it in a teapot it becomes the teapot. Now water can flow or it can crash. Be water, my friend.\". Technique+++ Gain a buff that increases your technique and power.

\"Don't ever slam on the breaks! Life's all about putting everything on the line and going further beyond!\" - Super Meta Senkai. Increase your speed even further, and gain a temporary buff called Speed, which increases your speed and power to insane levels.
Modifying the original breathing routine, the user works new, advanced breathing exercises into their martial arts techniques. KiMod+, Will+, Tech+
You're able to project a small blade from your hands that increases your attack. It will initially drain some Ki.
The Ki inside you is normally sealed, but today you'll let it out, just this once. (Disclaimer: by 'once', you mean all the time.) KiOff+, P.Off+
Using the same idea as before, project a larger blade that does more damage, but drains constantly. You can also change the icon of the blade in Settings!
You're able to project a shield from your hands that increases your defense and attack a bit. It will initially drain some Ki.
Increase your Ki's sharpness, resulting in higher damage output. KiOff+
Add a description here.
A customizable beam attack.
A customizable blast attack.
The user forms a habit of breathing exercises that calms the nerves, improves the senses, and keeps one motivated. KiMod+, Will+
Probably one of the most forceful beams in the game, it has good max range and damage, and average everything else
Has a decent damage output at great speed, but it's expensive and doesn't travel very far.
Burn items to make magical power, which fuels other rituals. (Does not do anything without a ritual nearby)
The user learns to give power to others.
The user's spiritual prowess grants them further willpower bonuses. KiMod+, Will+
The hidden potential of your breathing exercises unlocks! You can heal yourself slightly with your strengthed breathing. Your healing is impacted by your willpower. KiMod++, Will+
Your physical power is unbound, with no peers. Physical Offense++++
Raze entire planets underneath your palms.
When you invest into this, you're allowing your body to go beyond 50 mastery in any given Ki department. Also, you'll gain boosts to Ki level based on BP, similar to Milestones. KiSkill+
Increase your magic capacity a bit further, and passively start to absorb mana.
Your magical abilities start to awaken!!
Learn how to push power through your own words, unleashing limitless possiblities.
Prime your magical abilities further, increasing your mana capacity and skill. (Estoric Skill+++, Magic Capcity+)
Use a ritual to gain Magic energy.
Increase your physical defense and offense even more, at a small price to Ki. Physoff++ Physdef++ Kiskill- Kioff-
You notice the cats around you being able to always land on their feet. In addition, the reflexes they show is astounding! Perhaps you can mimic that? Tech+, Spd+
You notice the dragons around you can sweep their tail to disorient foes. Perhaps you can mimic that? Tech+, P.Off+
The world around you becomes more apparent. In your Martial Arts, you begin to take more from nature. Tech++
The user learns to move like the wind and hit like a motherfucker. Foot edition. Spd+, Tech+, P.Off+
Begin the journey of mastering your own Martial Arts.\n Allows you to learn a custom Martial Art (Style), modify, and improve it.
You further push your reflexes, granting additional mobility and ability. Tech+, P.Off+, Spd+
A special multihit attack that crowds the opponent's body with punches.
You notice the tigers around you being able to savagely strike anything! Perhaps you can mimic that? Tech+, P.Off+
Mimic a wolf, repeatedly attacking an opponent with sharp blows..
Similarly to the Wolf Fang Fist, the Wolf Fang Hurricane is a flurry of blows. Except, in this case, it's more of a combination attack.
Using principles of both the Lariat and Afterimage techniques, you appear next to your opponent and strike! Practice can increase the number of subsequent attacks
You can survive off of just water now. Hunger seems to have vanished.
Increase your offense to incredible levels. Furthermore, gain the ability to temporarily expend more Ki into your body to increase your offense further.
The user learns to control his power. In order to actively power up or down, you must be standing still.
You've learned to keep the momentum of your strikes, feeding into a endless loop of fury upon a opponent. Speed++++
Research a single effect of a ingredient using this ritual.
Ensure your dominance over reality by researching rituals to further your quest for magical application.
Research a single magical word using this ritual.
Rip a hole in reality, and travel through it.
Deal a damaging stun to your target.
Increase your physical defense and offense even more, at a small price to Ki. Physoff+ Tech+
Your fighting spirit awakens! Your willpower increases, and you feel your stamina increase marginally!
You can create and fire a small Spirit Ball, dealing decent amounts of damage. This attack comes straight from your Stamina however, not your Ki. KiMod+, Will+
You can create and fire a small Spirit Fist, dealing decent amounts of damage from close range. This attack comes straight from your Stamina however, not your Ki. KiMod+, Will+
Deal a sword strike that targets all mobs in front of you at the same time.
Harness your skills with the blade. P.Off+++, Tech+
When holding a sword, your technique increases the longer you hold a blade. It resets upon unequipping your sword, and builds up to a maximum of three charges. Tech+
Your body is hardened, but soft. It's able to redirect any blow... Master of technique. Master of all. Technique++++
The user learns to read and speak to minds.
Begin learning the Way of the Tree. Essentially, gain the ability to pluck trees out of the ground, and channel Ki though them, allowing you to fight and do interesting things with them.
ULTRA DENSE BODY. OLD SPICE BOD- Increase your defense even further, and gain a temporary buff called Ultra Dense Body, which increases your defense and power to certifibly insane levels.
\"No longer will I be useless... and neither will they!\" - Anonymous. Give up your form to power up a player temporarily. Upon buff expiration or player KO, you're left vunerable.
Your technique related to grabs increases. PhysOff+ PhysDef+ Tech++
OH SHIT! THE WWE SUPER STAR IS REELING UP FOR A NEW MOVE... Using your skills, further your wrestling career, with a legendary move called the Suplex. Physoff++ Tech++++
Your grabbing technique becomes a bit more savage in nature. PhysOff++ Tech++
Grabbing becomes an art to you! You're an artist, the coolest of your kind... YOU'RE A SUPER STAR! PhysOff+ Tech+++
Charge up insane amounts of energy, and let it all go in one big explosion. Damage is dependent on how spread out it is, but it's generally less than Self Destruct. Can possibly destroy planets.
Scream into the cosmos, creating a small portal to Interdimension. Requires 40 billion expressed BP to accomplish.
Transform into the peak of your species!!
Vomit a projectile of poison damage towards a foe. The person it hits will become inflicted with short term poison damage. Kioff++
You're an Arlian, so you're built like a stick. Conversely, that means Ki flows through you easier, granting you more skill. KiMod+++, KiSkillMod+++
Bug life is hard. Your body reflects and grows to accomadate this, increasing stamina and regeneration rates, along with a bit of durability. P.Def+, Regen+, Will++
The user practices their striking abilities. P.Off++, Tech+
The user goes the extra mile for their bulk.\nCaution: this has some ramifications for your speed. P.Def+++, P.Off+, Spd-
The user learns to take the world apart a bit better. KiOff++
The user turns their focus into a weapon. KiSkill++
The user improves their active defense. P.Def+, Tech+
The user learns the basics of fist-to-fist combat. P.Off+, P.Def+, Tech++
Precision for the sake of precision. Tech+++, KiMod+
The user spends some time bulking up instead of working on practical muscle.\nCaution: this has some ramifications for your speed. P.Def++, Spd-
Your Ki flows all around you. You don't need to direct it, and your experienced body will flow with it. Ki Skill+, Technique+++
Using a magic ritual, conjure a demon. Demons usually like being summoned.

As a Demigod, you are what mortals would normally call a God. Whether or not that's the truth, is up to you. However, you are not considered as such for no reason. By choosing this, you augment your physical offense, and grant yourself a flexible powerup based on the element.
Use your innate Demon abilities to tear into the universe itself, granting you access wherever...
You become able to channel your anger to further increase your power.

Feed on the energies of the other person, increasing your energy, power, and time you'll be in your prime. This is the only type of absorb that doesn't kill the other person, but it does take their decline.
Tear into the very essence of a person and absorb their soul. You can only absorb a soul if the target is knocked out.
The user undergoes intense training to improve the quality of their legs.\nAllows you to do a very rudimentary Rush Attack, the Lariat. Spd+, P.Off+
Your ki attacks erupt with force! You begin to knock foes back with every blow! You can only choose one effusion specialization.
Your ki attacks seem to dampen energy! You increase your target's drain from ki attacks! You can only choose one effusion specialization.
Your ki attacks crackle with energy! Your attacks leave behind residual energy, causing damage! You can only choose one effusion specialization.
The user practices agile movement. Spd+, Tech+
The user learns to use their Ki to expand their muscles.
Channel your Ki into your legs, increasing speed. Ki Skill+, Speed+++
The user learns to propel themself into the air with a controlled flow of Ki.
The user further intensifies their focus. KiOff+, P.Off+, KiSkill++
The user enhances their force of will through intense concentration. KiOff+++
You know it exists, and you know how to prevent it. You know how to get out of it, but you can't. You just don't have control. But you're on the verge of figuring it out...
You're aware of it. The beast lurking inside every Saiyan warrior. It's the first step to dominance over it. Learning this skill will let you revert from the form at higher levels of mastery.
You know what triggers it- it's the moon. Allow yourself the ability to choose to look at the moon or not, thus eliminating risks.

The main issue with the Oozaru State is that it's big and bulky. All that extra speed in close quarters combat is lost due to efficiency of movement. Compress the power of Oozaru into a smaller package that you can activate whenever. There is a price to this, however...
The user starts to master the Legendary form, with the end result of almost eliminating the drain, and increasing the power a bit.
The user achieves a bit more than the strength of Ultra Super Saiyan, except without any drain or speed reductions.
The user masters Super Saiyan 2, almost eliminating the drain, and increasing the power a bit.
Begin mastering Super Saiyan, which will unlock new forms down the road.
After mastering Super Saiyan, you can directly transform into any available form instantly, without having to go through every form.
The user pushes the Super Saiyan form far beyond the state of Super Saiyan 2 to achieve greatness.
Almost eliminates the drain of Super Saiyan 3, and increases it's power a little bit.

Shatter the final limit. Available only after fully mastering Super Saiyan 4 Full Power. Once learned, transform again while in Full Power to ascend to the Super Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker (Primal Saiyan only).
The user pushes Ki into every muscle within the user's body, increasing power - and drain, of the Super Saiyan form. Has lower speed.
As a product of extreme ki mastery, a competent Gray is able to focus their power until it begins to grow exponentially.\nObtain this skill to begin that process.
Your body becomes slightly harder, allowing yourself to take attacks more easily. P.Def+++
Your body becomes slightly taller and skinnier, allowing you to move faster. Tech++, Spd++
This cures a permanently shapeshifted shapeshifter... at a small price. (Mutation chance, Lowered BP, Knockout, reset Gravity and reset physical age.)
Your arms become gifted with extra strength, allowing you to hit harder. P.Off+
Your mind scrunches up, focused on one task. You won't give up easily, no matter what. StamGain+, Will+, Satiety+
Grab someone, then bring them into yourself, giving yourself a power boost.
Engulf someone with your tail, then bring them into yourself, giving yourself a power boost.
Cover someone with your flesh, then bring them into yourself, giving yourself a power boost.
Disguise yourself as somebody else!
Become invisibile.
Kikoho is a powerful attack that takes some of your health as a price.
Learn a magic ritual to materialize items through Ki.
Project a mental image of a person you wish to observe, and you can do so from many distances away.
Regenerate some damage, using energy in the process. You can target a limb to specify the healing process.
Kill yourself, dealing major damage to a opponent.
Split your body into two copies, halving your expressed BP.

Cause the world to halt still. Air particles and individual raindrops frozen midair. Not even light moves. Comes with a massive drawback: it takes 1/4th of your Ki per time stop, and people above 50 billion and your own BP can circumvent time itself.
Stop time, and move to a location, To everyone else, it is instant. (Time Stop for 2 seconds. Non-trainable.)
Stop Time for a few people around you.
The user learns to move like the wind and hit like a motherfucker. Spd+, Tech+, P.Off+
Gain more power while meditating. You have a buff that only increases when your intelligence increases.
Gain extra power while meditating. In addition, this unlocks more skills down the line, for both Hermanos and Grays.
The user manifests a bastion of Ki below their heart. KiMod++
Increase your energy modifiers, allowing you to power up even further.
Supercharge your energy during a fight for an explosive increase in power!
Master your max power transformation, gradually reducing the drain and increasing the multiplier by a bit.
Master your true max power transformation, gradually reducing the drain and increasing the multiplier by a bit.

A racial ability the race of Hera has is to manipulate strings. Created by subconciousness, these are normally mundane and undetectable. Under conditions, you can create them wherever. They're great at stunning enemies.
As a human, your willpower can get to insane proportions, granting you the ability to go days without food. StamGain++, Will++
Humans can be pretty darn smart, but only if they choose to be. If you do focus on your brain, you might find other things lacking. TechMod*, P.Def-, KiOff-
As a human, you can do anything. Likewise, your ability to do everything increases. Perhaps if you meditate on what you've learned... Stats+++
Gain additional technique, which is natural to your race. Perhaps if you focus and meditate on your technique... Tech++++
Tap into your Golden Form, granting you an even higher boost than your final evolution. In addition, it'll give you God Ki energy (but not anything else) temporarily. Has a high strain on the body.
Unleash your hidden potential. Your hidden potential is dictated as the strength you didn't have while young, and any reincarnation bonuses.
Resurrect someone from the dead.
Tap into your reserves of otherwordly energy to instantly teleport to any other planet.
The user synchronizes their Ki with their body, forcing it to multiply dramatically, regardless of the consequences.

Using 10 stored time (equal to 10 years worth of time), set a chronoic \"respawn\" point. Upon using this skill again, you'll revert back to that point with however much Ki, Stamina, Age, and Health you had when you set it up, destroying it. This can revert death.

As you live, store Time Energy within yourself, preventing aging. You can then touch yourself or others to give 'time'. If applied to someone, they gain a temporary speed boost at the price of some age. Stored Time might have other uses too.
See into the future just a wee bit to dodge incoming blasts.
The user expends ki to move at extreme speeds. While at first it's difficult and has limited range, skilled users can seemingly teleport.
A short-range, highly concentrated take on energy waves. While it is generally stronger, it takes significantly more Ki to maintain.\nUnskilled fighters will struggle to even charge it.
The user learns to gather their Ki into a shield.
Tecnica antiga: deu lugar a Spirit Bomb.
The user expends their ki to slowly heal their target. Not for the unskilled or the unworthy.
The user learns to concentrate their ki into a beam.
The user learns eject masses of Ki and redirect them towards their Target.
The user learns to spread Ki violently in the form of light.
The user focuses their free-flowing Ki towards their groin. P.Off+, KiOff-, KiMod+

You're a true legend, with fury that runs deeper than any other Saiyan. When you rage, it pushes your power a full extra 1x past the normal limit (your rage cap goes from 2x to 3x). That's all it does- no sacrificed form, no drawbacks.
As a Legendary Super Saiyan, your power is maximum! And now, your maximum power is maximum! This doubles your ki capacity... And your drain.
Your Legendary Super Saiyan form bursts with energy! You now gain even more ki in this form!

If you're not angry and have an absorb, immediately heal completely, expelling all absorbs and gaining an anger boost. When you lose the anger or debuff, your Stamina and Ki are set to their minimums.
Gain a boost in speed and technique for less defense. If you're ascended, there's no defense penalty, and a decent BP boost and energy boost.
Sacrifice your Makyo Star boost for a massive gains and BP boost while under Daylight. However, as a price, you'll also have less BP than normal during nighttime.
As a makyo, the Makyo Star empowers you. Gain a magical boost with the Moon.
As a makyo, the Makyo Star empowers you. Gain the same boost with the Sun, but at a somewhat smaller rate.
Immediately gain some more magical mastery. The moon increases your magic passively.

Metamorians are best described as living robots. Their unique biology is not unlike human-sized transformers. Once upon a time, Metamorians were of many species. You may gain the traits of one of the three main races in the Metamorian Robotic Alliance.
Shoot a fast stunning projectile capable of knocking back others several tiles.
Further improve your proficiency with beam attacks.
Further improve your proficiency with blast attacks.

You have begun to efficiently channel your ki. This is the path to harnessing that skill.

You have learned to better muster your ki when your reserves run low. This is the path to harnessing that skill.

Improve your proficiency with targeted ki attacks, and learn more advanced techniques.
Improve your proficiency with rapid ki attacks, and learn more advanced techniques.
You begin to truly feel around you. The energy of life courses through the trees, water, and grass. And it flows through you too. Acquire this skill to begin your journey to ki mastery.
Perfect your proficiency with beam attacks.
Perfect your proficiency with blast attacks.
Perfect your proficiency with ki-based buffs.
Perfect your proficiency with ki-based debuffs.

Truly master circulating ki to improve your power.

Master your ability to expel your ki.

Perfect your proficiency with kiai attacks.
Perfect your proficiency with targeted ki attacks.
Perfect your proficiency with rapid ki attacks.
The user habitually neglects their body to further their mind.\nIntensifies your ki, but at what cost? KiOff++, KiDef++, KiSkill++, P.Off-, P.Def-
Your ability to maneuver more Ki at a time increases. KiOff+, Blast Number++
Unleash your inner Gumby... by pressing grab, if you have a target, your arms will track down your foe and keep them still while you can freely move around.
Unlock what you might call \"Peak Namekian Perfection!\"! You need to be around two million in order to use this.
Become Huge, increasing your strength by a lot. This is not the same as Body Expand.
Ask someone if they'd like to fuse. If so, they will recieve your power and you will be sent to the Sealed Realm.
The user manifests their power in the world, further developing their Ki but also enhancing their physical abilities. KiOff++, P.Off+, Spd+
The user works on their gains. P.Off+, P.Def+
The user leverages a bit of their precision back into raw Ki power with great effect. KiOff++, KiSkill-
The user improves their coordination. P.Off+, Tech+
The user improves their all-around ability to respond to threats. P.Def+, Tech+, Spd+
The user practices running up elevated planks for better control over their balance. Spd+, Tech+
Appoint a Elder, to the position of North, West, East, or South elder.
A absolute wave of blasts, this fucker will guarentee destroy anything in your path.
A multiball blast.
Allows you to view who online is dead. Or, you could, y'know, look at their goddamn Halo.

The Dead Zone is a area where all sealed people go to. If your soul vanishes from existance, the Dead Zone is where you go. Open up a portal to the extreme Void, dragging any unfortunate soul into its depths. Whether or not the person can regain freedom is dependent on your power when opening up the tear.
A guided ball blast. Very destructive, but also it drains a lot! Very accurate too, but you can't make this non-lethal. You can charge it up to four times its regular strength.
Like the Dodompa and the Makankosappo, focus on one specific point. However, the low drain, high speed, and high attack means this is perfect for killing.
Your link to the Emerald allows you to detect its energy. If a trace of the Emerald's energy is on the same planet as you, you can trace its coordinates.
Technically more powerful than the Kamehameha, this attack is perfect for high damage and assassination.

A powerful Ki attack, in a beam form. This Ki attack prioritizes constant jagged push and maximizing output. At it's best, it's a tsunami of Ki, obliterating foes much higher than the user's own strength.
Learn a powerful- but temporary- means of fusing one person with another, increasing their power significantly, and seperating when it wears off.
A powerful Ki attack, in a beam form. This Ki attack prioritizes attack and minimizing drain. At it's best and most controlled, more like a extended arm of Ki, rather than a straight projectile.
Inbue a Bean with magical water-life-energy, becoming enriched with energy. It'll heal and feed pretty darn well.
Your connection to the Master Emerald allows you to enter and exit the Holy Summit as you please. The method is a secret to everyone, but it causes you to feel an urge to laugh..?
When people first come to Checkpoint, they are judged. This is that ability. Choose whether or not someone is sent to Heaven or Hell.
Give permission to a person to use the facilities of the Kai Loft and/or Hallowed Realm, located in Heaven.

Tome discipulos de qualquer raca e confie a eles o recorte do saber divino que cabe a um aprendiz: cura, telepatia, observacao e a visao dos mortos. Ha um limite de discipulos simultaneos, e o vinculo acaba quando voce deixa o trono.

nome: Turtle School - Kamehameha | Turtle Destruction Wave
desc: A powerful Ki attack, in a beam form. This Ki attack prioritizes constant push and minimizing drain. At it's best and most controlled, more like a extended arm of Ki, rather than a straight projectile.
Allow someone to keep their form and energy contained while dead.
A stun attack that does damage in addition to a good stun.

Mafuba is a pretty deadly skill. In exchange for most of your life, (90%) you'll seal someone permanently inside a dummy jar. They can't escape the beam very easily, but if the container ever were to get damaged, the sealed will easily break free.

O segredo mais profundo do Cla do Dragao: moldar uma Estatua do Dragao e dar vida a um set de Esferas. A estatua so pode ser erguida na Terra (sendo o Guardiao da Terra) ou num planeta que voce dominou.

A concentrated Ki attack, in a beam form. This Ki attack prioritizes pinpoint thrust and extremely fast speed. At it's best, it's a attack whose density is greater than a white dwarf star, yet no smaller than a penny.
Narrate for those in view, speaking in a voice decentralized and neutral to your own.

This attack doesnt really do any damage unless the opponent is pretty weak, but if it makes contact it can paralyze the opponent for up to 60 seconds, it cannot be deflected or blocked but it is rather slow.
Give permission to a person to use the facilities of the Lookout.
If you have a rank, you can get this. Used to speak OOCly between ranks.
Reshape somebodys soul, and let them be reborn. Not only does this give them a fresh start at life, but it technically wipes everything, letting bad be reborn as good... or the reverse.
Bring someone to the prime of their youth!
Resurrect people from the dead. If it is somebody's second time getting resurrected like this, you must trade your life to do it.
Create a fruit capable of dooming a planet for a power increase.

Create a ball of good energy, and either launch a extremely powerful attack at your foe, or absorb it for a passive, temporary, and powerful boost in strength. The former only works if the afflicted is evil-hearted, and the latter only works if you are kind-hearted.

Seal a target person inside a object or another person. Objects are haphazard, and can be broken by power leakage easily. People, on the other hand, can contain it. The sealed can break free should the lifeform in question ever die, or can weaken the seal by seeping through the persons anger.
Learn the ultimate power that brings all to their knees- accounting. Using your rule, learn how to make the chumps below you learn who they pay.
Allows you to increase the BP of somebody massively.
The user pumps excess Ki into their nerves and muscles in equal measures to obtain radically increased speed.
Vomit a projectile of poison damage towards a foe. The person it hits will become inflicted with short term poison damage.
As a Saibaman, you're naturally crafty. Gain some Technique and the ability to use some... underhanded methods. (Rock Paper Scissors, which punishes the opponent depending on conditions.) Tech+
A Saibaman never stops growing. And whenever they grow, their power increases, just a little bit. Use this verb to gain some physical age, but a massive temporary energy increase in exchange. KiMod+

This one lets you maximize your usage of Zenkai. Normally Zenkai is already pretty strong, but this will let you get stronger by fighting in combat. The longer you're in a fight, the more passive gains you'll get...
The user senses their surroundings.
Shiver your body apart and translate it to another place using your target's Ki as a homing beacon.\nAs difficult as it sounds.
Instead of needing strictly a pod, fly up to space on your own.
Your parts stitch together faster, giving you a bit of death regen. You can't have Play Hard at the same time.
As your body stresses, it grows stronger. Punishment hardens the doll's frame. P.Def+. Can't have Doll Regeneration at the same time.
Channel your Ki into your body, increasing defense. Ki Skill+, Physical Defense+++
A truly strange and weird form, the Alien Style is home the universe's greatest fighting ideas. It's speed and technique suffer though.
Learn how to accurately strike and attack foes, hitting them in the most vital of areas.
A savage but strangely elegant style that reeks of superiority.
